casamatch.title: CasaMatch
casamatch.summary: Peer-to-peer real-estate marketplace prototype — Tinder-style swipe on Next.js 16.
casamatch.description:
Peer-to-peer real-estate marketplace prototype. Swipe-based discovery (Tinder meets Idealista), built on Next.js 16 App Router with Zustand for state (persisted to localStorage), Framer Motion for the swipe gestures, and shadcn/ui on Tailwind v4.

The prototype covers the full journey: mock SPID login, role onboarding (seeker / offeror / both), discover feed with 50 mock properties and a 200-city fuzzy autocomplete, match and chat with auto-reply, privacy-blind reveal (address and documents unlock after a match), and a FREE/BASE/PRO/ELITE subscription system with daily limits on swipes, super-likes and rewinds.

personal-website.title: Personal Portfolio
personal-website.summary: This site. Angular 18 in an Nx monorepo, custom canvas hero, EN/IT.
personal-website.description: This site. Angular 18 inside an Nx monorepo, Tailwind for styling, a hand-rolled canvas hero (aurora orbs + mouse-reactive particle network), scramble text, magnetic CTAs, scroll-driven reveals, and ngx-translate for EN/IT. Hosted on GitHub Pages.

smart-rockets.title: Smart Rockets
smart-rockets.summary: Genetic-algorithm sandbox — rockets evolve to get past drawn obstacles.
smart-rockets.description: A genetic-algorithm sandbox. You draw the obstacle path, the rockets evolve across generations to reach the target. Learning rate, population size and mutation randomness are editable at runtime. It was a school project, but it's still fun to watch.

monthly-expenses-app.title: Monthly Expenses
monthly-expenses-app.summary: Ionic + Angular mobile app for tracking personal expenses.
monthly-expenses-app.description: Cross-platform mobile app built with Ionic + Angular to track daily expenses. Category breakdown, monthly budget overview, charts, data export. Runs on Android and iOS.

about.title: About
about.name: Gbohou Indji Israel
about.bio: Full-Stack developer with 4+ years of experience, primarily on Java and Angular. I have worked on corporate programs for banking-sector clients, both greenfield initiatives and day-to-day evolution of long-lived services. I value readable, maintainable code — the kind that doesn't need to be rewritten six months later. I work well in Agile teams, particularly in engagements where the client is part of the process.
about.ai: Outside office hours I focus on AI-native development: I use Claude Code daily, experiment with MCP servers and agent SDKs, and build small products such as CasaMatch or tools for personal use. Staying current is part of the craft — new primitives ship every year, and I would rather work with them than only read about them.
